Description: Runs the Claude Code CLI as the coding agent of a workflow; credentials reach the agent container just-in-time.

Settings.Label: Claude account
Settings.HelpText: The connected Claude account (company or personal) the CLI runs with. Preferred over an API key; stored encrypted and never displayed back.

Settings.Label: Anthropic API key (fallback)
Settings.HelpText: Fallback when no Claude account is connected. Delivered to the agent container just-in-time and passed to the CLI only via its process environment.

Settings.Label: Model
Settings.HelpText: Optional model override (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6); the CLI's default model is used when empty.

Settings.Label: CLI path
Settings.HelpText: Path of the Claude Code executable inside the workflow image; only changed for testing.
